commands.detail: bootstrap + native-bootstrap + coordination suites, zero failures/skips
run.json binds the current revision commit on a clean tree

environment.engines: pypdfium2 5.8.0 / PDFium 149.0.7825.0, pypdf 6.18.0; no OCR or model use in this task

measured_decisions.decision: Render-mode integers are interpreted with content-stream Tr semantics and the raw integer is recorded beside the interpreted name
measured_decisions.reason: Empirically verified on this build: `3 Tr` (PDF invisible) reads back as raw 3, although pypdfium2's enum NAMES 3 'FILL_STROKE' and reserves 4 for INVISIBLE. Mapping the integer through the enum names would misreport every invisible text object as fill+stroke (the exact wrong assumption the task anchor warns against). Raw+name recording makes the divergence auditable; the Tr 0..7 sweep test pins the semantics.
measured_decisions.tradeoff: Consumers must read the interpreted name, not the raw int; both always travel together.

measured_decisions.decision: Paint overlap is an approximate top-level opaque-rectangle comparison and is never a visibility label
measured_decisions.reason: CAPABILITIES.md defines the native overlap path as an 'approximate bounded opaque-rectangle experiment' with 'no automatic hidden/safe label'; the F02 covered fixture records the later white cover over the $1,000 text as an index fact only.
measured_decisions.tradeoff: No causal visibility answer is possible from this check; consumers combine it with render mode if needed.

limitations: F04 (white-contrast), F05 (paint-order) and F06 (partial-clip) fixture families are catalog 'specified' on this base and are not yet generated in fixtures/; their criteria are covered here with committed fixtures where available (F03, F02 overlap control, F07 families) plus hand-assembled in-memory minimal PDFs in the tests. Committed families remain a fixture-lane dependency request.
Top-level objects only: nested Form XObject contents are not traversed (bounded record emitted instead); blends, transparency groups, OCG and historical revisions are not inspected.
Object bounds are PDFium-reported axis-aligned bounds in user space, mapped to canonical page space with the documented C transform (UserUnit once); they are API geometry, not exact visible ink.
Compositing inside alpha fills is recorded as unsupported; no occlusion or overprint semantics are computed.

Per-occurrence compositing flags cover transparency, soft masks and non-Normal blend modes via FPDFPageObj_HasTransparency (empirically verified: /BM /Multiply and /Screen objects are flagged). Optional-content (/OC BDC) membership has no per-object getter on this binding: objects drawn inside OC contexts may emit ordinary records with no compositing limitation. A completed structural check therefore never certifies that all compositing contexts were inspected (no false 'all checked').
dependency_requests: Fixture owner lane: generate committed F04/F05/F06 families per the catalog recipes; the check consumes pages generically, so no adapter change is expected.
attribution: No external material reused; the check implements the project's own contracts against the installed PDFium binding. Contract-cited source ideas (S27 object API) are credited in planning/research/SOURCES.md.

Invisible-over-border and white-on-dark.detail: The module emits no verdict field of any kind; render mode, fill color and overlap are recorded as document properties whose limitations state 'not a hidden or visible verdict'. Tests prove the F03 invisible layer (13 objects, `3 Tr`) and the raster-only control both complete without any alert concept; synthesized F04-style white-on-dark vs white-on-light controls produce byte-identical mode/color records (locator and basis equal) and JSON output free of any hidden/visible/verdict string in all three capabilities. Concrete proof points (test names and module behavior) are itemized in artifacts/tasks/T28/criterion-evidence-current.md.

no false “all checked”.detail: Every planned check reaches a typed terminal (completed/unsupported/failed/cancelled); unsupported capability, region-scoped plans and out-of-range pages are 'unsupported'; the finite object budget returns 'resource_limit' while retaining all prior evidence; unsupported compositing (alpha fills, nested Form XObjects) and the narrow top-level scope are recorded as per-occurrence limitations and manifest limits, so a completed result never implies comprehensive inspection. Concrete proof points (test names and module behavior) are itemized in artifacts/tasks/T28/criterion-evidence-current.md.

off-crop observation uses raw/native geo.detail: Crop-box mapping never clips: text objects outside the crop-box effective view are emitted with their unclipped canonical polygons (coordinates outside the page extent preserved) plus the raw user-space box in the basis, with the limitation 'page display remains the crop'. The tests assert out-of-window corners survive for synthesized off-crop objects and the module keeps negative coordinates for a shrunk-crop variant. Concrete proof points (test names and module behavior) are itemized in artifacts/tasks/T28/criterion-evidence-current.md.

unsupported compositing explicitly recor.detail: Alpha compositing: a text object drawn under an ExtGState with ca/CA 0.5 records 'alpha compositing not inspected; fill alpha below 255'. Nested compositing: a Form XObject's contents are not traversed; a bounded form observation records 'compositing unsupported' and the nested text is NOT emitted (no false text link). The manifest records that blends, transparency groups, OCG and historical revisions are not inspected. Per-occurrence recording (review 1a00561 P2): objects participating in transparency (alpha or soft mask) are flagged per occurrence via FPDFPageObj_HasTransparency; blend modes (/BM) are not detectable per object on this binding (setter-only) and optional-content (/OC BDC) membership has no per-object getter, so the receipt-level limitation below explicitly states those contexts may emit ordinary records. Concrete proof points (test names and module behavior) are itemized in artifacts/tasks/T28/criterion-evidence-current.md.
